verdict.rationale: Motion's docs say you can "share your schedule anywhere" and embed its AI Calendar so prospects "book your ideal time slots instantly." Bookings respect daily meeting limits, which make the calendar unbookable, and draw on all your Google, Outlook and iCloud calendars combined into one view. Meeting templates set durations and pre-meeting questions, and video links are added automatically. Missing for 10: an explicit description of a standalone shareable booking link (the docs mainly describe embedding), detail on how invitees pick from real-time availability, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
